name: Hatchet
what_it_is: A business intelligence platform for gaming, esports and live streaming, covering creator discovery, audience analytics, campaign tracking and reporting; formerly sold as Stream Hatchet.
pricing: Three plans (Community, Data License, Full License) with no prices shown; the vendor routes buyers to a demo call.
notable: Founded in Barcelona in 2016, now part of GameSquare

facts.fact: Hatchet describes itself as business intelligence for gaming, esports and live streaming, for brands, publishers, research agencies and teams.
The pricing page lists three plans, Community, Data License and Full License, and sends buyers to book a demo; no price is shown.
The Data License covers creator and game discovery, fake audience scoring across 55M+ creators and 32 platforms, mention tracking, YouTube VOD analytics and esports benchmarking.
Hatchet was founded in Barcelona in 2016, started as a tool for streamers to understand their audiences and is now part of GameSquare.

name: Twitchmetrics
what_it_is: A statistics site for Twitch, YouTube and Kick channels and games, with business and streamer plans.
pricing: No price is shown in the readable text of the opened pages; the site separates a Business plan from a Streamer plan.
notable: Records only streams with 10 or more concurrent viewers

facts.fact: Twitchmetrics offers statistics on Twitch, YouTube and Kick channels, games and emotes.
The plan chooser offers a Business option and a Streamer option with advanced analytics only on the streamer's own channel.
According to its FAQ, the site records streams that reach 10 or more concurrent viewers.
